title: GOOD COFFEE. NO COMPROMISES.
paragraphs: At Velochique, coffee has always been more than just a drink. It's part of who we are, what we love and the experience we want to share.
From that first espresso of the morning to a leisurely flat white with friends, we believe great coffee is one of life's simple pleasures — and something worth taking the time to enjoy.
Our approach is straightforward: carefully selected beans, thoughtful preparation and a genuine passion for serving great coffee, every time.

title: FROM THE ROASTER TO YOUR CUP
paragraphs: Great coffee starts with great people.
We believe the quality of a coffee begins long before it reaches our espresso machine.
That's why we work with independent specialty coffee roasters who share our passion for quality, craftsmanship and flavour.
Closer to home, we're proud to work with Koyo and Clifftop, two Algarve-based roasters who are part of the region's growing specialty coffee scene.

We also explore coffees from established European roasters, including Ineffable in Spain and Tanat in France, bringing different origins, flavour profiles and roasting styles into the Velochique experience.
For us, it's about finding coffees we genuinely enjoy, supporting the people behind them and sharing something special with our customers.

title: CONSISTENCY WITH ROOM TO EXPLORE
paragraphs: Your favourite coffee, wherever you find us.
Whether you're visiting us in the mountains of Monchique or beside the river at Vista Rio, you'll find the same carefully selected coffee beans at the heart of our espresso offering.
We believe consistency matters. Your favourite flat white or morning espresso should be just as enjoyable at either location.
But we also love discovering new coffees.
Our batch brews give us the freedom to explore different beans, origins and flavour profiles, with selections that may change between locations and throughout the year.
It's an opportunity to try something new, experience the diversity of specialty coffee and perhaps discover a new favourite.

title: CRAFTED WITH CARE
paragraphs: It's the little details that make the difference.
Great beans deserve great preparation.
From grinding and extraction to milk texture and temperature, we pay attention to the details that help bring out the best in every coffee.
Whether you prefer a bold espresso, a smooth cappuccino, a balanced flat white or a refreshing iced latte, our aim is always the same: a consistently enjoyable cup of coffee.
And while we take our coffee seriously, we don't believe enjoying it should ever feel complicated.
No unnecessary fuss. No coffee snobbery. Just good coffee, prepared with care.

title: COFFEE & CYCLING
paragraphs: Great rides deserve great coffee.
There's always been a natural connection between cycling and coffee.
The early morning espresso before heading into the mountains. The mid-ride stop to refuel. The post-ride cappuccino when the bikes are parked and the conversation begins.
These moments are part of what inspired Velochique, and they remain at the heart of our identity.
But you don't need to be a cyclist to appreciate a great cup of coffee.
Whether you're exploring Monchique, relaxing beside the river in Portimão or simply catching up with friends, there's always a good reason to stop for coffee.

title: TWO LOCATIONS. ONE PASSION FOR COFFEE.
paragraphs: From our original café in the mountains of Monchique to Velochique Vista Rio on Portimão's waterfront, our passion for coffee remains the same.
Each location has its own character, but both share a commitment to quality, friendly service and creating somewhere people genuinely enjoy spending time.
Because, for us, great coffee isn't just about what's in the cup.
It's about the moments that come with it.
